# World Population Review

> > Comprehensive global demographic data and population statistics for countries, cities, and continents worldwide.

World Population Review provides up-to-date population data, demographic trends, and statistical rankings for countries, territories, cities, and regions. The site covers international organizations (G7, European Union), economic classifications (newly industrialized countries), and detailed geographic breakdowns with GDP, density, and growth metrics.

## Key Topics

- Population statistics and demographics
- Country rankings and comparisons
- G7 countries (United States, Japan, Germany, France, Italy, United Kingdom, Canada)
- European Union member states and Schengen Area
- Global economics and GDP statistics
- Advanced and emerging economies
- Continental population distribution
- City population rankings
- International organizations
- China and India demographics
- Russia and North America
- Newly industrialized countries
- Eurozone membership
- Population density and growth rates

## Global Population Overview

- [Population by Continent 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/continents): Global population statistics by continent with area and density data

## International Organizations & Economic Groups

- [G7 Countries 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/g7-countries): Rankings of G7 member countries (US, Japan, Germany) with economic stats
- [List of Countries in the European Union 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/european-union-countries): Complete list of EU member states with membership and Schengen details
- [Newly Industrialized Countries 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/newly-industrialized-countries): Rankings of emerging economies like Turkey, Malaysia, China by GDP growth

## City Population Rankings

- [Pakistan Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/pakistan): Population rankings of Pakistani cities including Karachi and Lahore

## Country & Territory Profiles

- [Puerto Rico Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/puerto-rico): Puerto Rico demographics and population profile for Caribbean territory
